class.name: Layer2D
class.brief_description: Represents a Ciallo compositing layer and enables offscreen rendering only when required.
class.description: A [Layer2D] retains its layer identity while its children draw directly into the current target when no separate source is needed. The renderer selects transparent composition before drawing, using layer opacity, non-default blending, effective material, clipping relationships, child blending, local ordering, and [member composite_mode]. A default layer also composites when a sibling uses its combined result as a clipping base. Child operations using Add, Subtract, Multiply (including eraser shaders), or Replace require an isolated layer source. Source-over blending permits direct drawing. An isolated child contains its internal operations, while its own output blend may require the parent to composite too. Clipped output is contained by the clipping stack; the base's output blend determines the enclosing requirement. Child Z ordering is contained within this layer. A layer with content that needs a local ordering boundary uses transparent composition. This includes negative child Z indices used for onion-skin previews. Clipping requires direct sibling layers to use [member CanvasItem.z_index] = [code]0[/code], [member CanvasItem.z_as_relative] = [code]true[/code], [member CanvasItem.show_behind_parent] = [code]false[/code], and [member CanvasItem.top_level] = [code]false[/code], with [member CanvasItem.y_sort_enabled] = [code]false[/code] on their parent. When clipping is combined with custom Z, absolute Z, drawing behind the parent, or Y sorting in the same sibling group, ordering takes priority: the renderer warns and ignores that group's clipping until the conflict is removed. Nested groups are evaluated independently. [b]Note:[/b] This custom node is intended for the RD renderer path. The Compatibility renderer is outside the supported product boundary.

members.member: Sets the margin used to expand the transparent composite clearing rectangle.

If [code]true[/code], clips this layer to the nearest preceding direct sibling layer with clipping disabled. Sibling indices increase in back-to-front drawing order; Ciallo's layer panel displays that order in reverse. The base's complete alpha is preserved, including transparent holes. A missing or hidden base gives zero clipping coverage. Ordering conflicts suspend clipping without changing this property.
Controls whether the layer selects compositing automatically or always uses the transparent CanvasGroup path.
Sets the margin used to expand the drawable rectangle of a composited layer.
Selects the runtime layer blend override. The default selection preserves the effective canvas shader blend declaration.

method.name: is_composite_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the renderer selected a separate source for this layer during its most recent visible canvas traversal. The value updates during rendering, not immediately when a property changes. When multiple viewports share the canvas, it reflects the most recent traversal of this layer.
